title: Phir Chahe Sakina Ko Wo Jitna Bhi Sata Lay
body:
Haye....
Tha bain sakina ka Hai rukne ko mera dil
Jata hai rida cheen ke Beshir ka qatil
Asan ye karde mere bhaiya meri mushkil
Areh gauhar bhi nhi chahiye na chahiye mehmil
Karde jo mere sir ki ridha mere hawale
<<MINI>>
Phir Chahe Sakina Ko Wo Jitna Bhi Sata Lay x2
<<DIVIDER>>
1) Khanjar se gala sheh ka mere samne kata
Pathar tane mazloom pe mare gaie bhaiya
Zakhmo pe magar baba ke ab ret na dale
<<MINI>>
Phir Chahe Sakina Ko Wo Jitna Bhi Sata Lay x2
<<DIVIDER>>
2) Gauhar mere chine ye sitam maine saha hai
Areh khun mera sitam gar ke hatho pe laga hai
Bus mera lahoo hato se wo apne hata le
<<MINI>>
Phir Chahe Sakina Ko Wo Jitna Bhi Sata Lay x2
<<DIVIDER>>
3) Rahwar ko taiyaar jo karte hai musalman
Bhaiya ye sitam dekh ke mar jaienge amma
Pamal se lasha ali asgar ka bacha le
<<MINI>>
Phir Chahe Sakina Ko Wo Jitna Bhi Sata Lay x2
<<DIVIDER>>
4) Karta hai dukhi shah ki humsheer ko jaise
Areh lehra ta hai wo chadare tatheer ko jaise
Naize pe mere baba ka sir yu na uchale
<<MINI>>
Phir Chahe Sakina Ko Wo Jitna Bhi Sata Lay x2
<<DIVIDER>>
5) Talwaro se cehre pa kaie zakhm lage hai
Mazloom ke ye hoth toh pehle se kate hai
Ab baba ke hoto se chadi apni hatha le
<<MINI>>
Phir Chahe Sakina Ko Wo Jitna Bhi Sata Lay x2
<<DIVIDER>>
6) Hum se sahi jati nahi tasho ki azhiyat
Hashte hai laee dekh ke humsaro ki halat
Raste se hamare ye tamashaie hata le
<<MINI>>
Phir Chahe Sakina Ko Wo Jitna Bhi Sata Lay x2
<<DIVIDER>>
7) Mai apne liye chahu toh nhi mangti bhaiya
In shaam ki raho me fakat waqt de itna
Daman se karu saaf tere pairo ke chale
<<MINI>>
Phir Chahe Sakina Ko Wo Jitna Bhi Sata Lay x2
<<DIVIDER>>
8) Akbar thi tadap kar ye sakina ki sadaie
Areh rakhta hai sire gazi pe behno ki ridae
Ye chadare wo sir se chacha jaan ke uthale
<<MINI>>
Phir Chahe Sakina Ko Wo Jitna Bhi Sata Lay x2
